description: Réservoirs souterrains de stockage de gaz naturel en Wallonie (BE) is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SPW-SG Secrétariat général. This INSPIRE data layer brings together the boundaries of underground natural gas storage tanks and the areas considered to be stripped in Wallonia. Coverage: SPW-SG Secrétariat général. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE - Underground natural gas storage tanks in Wallonia (BE)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SPW-SG Secrétariat général. Its keywords include concession minière, houille, concession, gisement, minerai, mine. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GEOJSON, GMZ, WMS. The listing shows 2024-11-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
